import HartshorneLib.Chapter4CanonicalDivisorSheafBridge
import HartshorneLib.Chapter4DivisorModuleMul

/-!
# Transport of canonical divisor modules

Rescaling a nonzero rational differential changes its divisor by a principal
divisor.  Multiplication by the inverse rescaling function therefore gives an
isomorphism between the associated divisor modules.  The rescaling is an
explicit choice; this file records the resulting choice-dependent transport
without calling either module a canonical object.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory AlgebraicGeometry

namespace Hartshorne

noncomputable section

variable {k : Type u} [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k]
variable (X : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) [IsIntegral X.left]
  [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 X.hom] [IsProper X.hom]

/-- A chosen rescaling of a nonzero rational differential transports its
divisor module to the divisor module of the rescaled differential. -/
noncomputable def canonicalDivisorModuleTransport
    (a : X.left.functionFieldˣ)
    (ω : CurveRationalDifferentials X) (hω : ω ≠ 0) :
    divisorModule (differentialDivisor X ω hω) ≅
      divisorModule
        (differentialDivisor X ((a : X.left.functionField) • ω)
          (smul_ne_zero (Units.ne_zero a) hω)) := by
  have hdiv :
      differentialDivisor X ((a : X.left.functionField) • ω)
          (smul_ne_zero (Units.ne_zero a) hω) =
        differentialDivisor X ω hω - principalDivisor a⁻¹ := by
    rw [differentialDivisor_smul_of_nonzero X a ω hω,
      principalDivisor_inv]
    abel
  rw [hdiv]
  exact mulEquivDivisorModule a⁻¹ (differentialDivisor X ω hω)

end
end Hartshorne
